note: P4298 (Pro 27:11) — be wise, my son, and gladden my heart, that I may answer him who reproaches me.

dims.v: the son's wisdom — that gladdens and vindicates the father
the wisdom the father urges on his son — a wisdom that both gladdens the father's heart and lets him answer any who reproach him
the gladness it brings the father (266365)
welded to the joy a wise son gives
chakam (be wise) — 'be WISE, my son, and make my heart glad'; the son's wisdom is the father's joy and vindication. A wise child gladdens the parent and silences his critics (cf 23:15, 24-25).
parental joy — gladdened by a wise son, answering reproach
the gladness a wise son brings the father's heart — joy that also arms him to answer those who reproach him, the wise child being the parent's living vindication
the son's wisdom that brings it (266362)
welded to the wisdom that gladdens and vindicates

samach (be glad) — 'and make my HEART glad, that I may answer him who reproaches me'; a wise son is a parent's gladness and his answer to critics. The child's wisdom vindicates the parent's labour (cf 23:15-16).
taunt answered — the critic a wise son lets the father silence
the one who reproaches the father, whose taunt a wise son enables him to answer — the critic silenced by the living evidence of a well-raised child
the wise son who answers him (266362)
set against the wise son whose life refutes the taunt
charaph (reproach/taunt) — 'that I may answer him who REPROACHES me'; the critic who taunts the parent is answered not by words but by a wise child. A son's wisdom is the father's reply to reproach.
